notes.title: 0.5.9.1 added features
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to all the playtesters helping make this a truly special game. Based on feedback, I've adjusted or added the following:
- goal shield collision while carrying ball fixed[/p][p]- higher minimum throw speed[/p][p]- instant enhanced max throw following an air skill for a brief amount of time, to reward use of air skills and incentive chaining together moves[/p][p]- ball cam when wall jumping camera issue fixed[/p][p]- slightly higher maximum wall jump speed[/p][p]- slightly faster wall jump strength load[/p][p]- visual indicator of attack sphere when attacking
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477684/e59efbe5ca20b5e3abe21223822b0bfc70a40af1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 0.5.9 - New Level Added!
notes.content: [p][b]🚀 New Arena: Celestial Divide is Live![/b][/p][p]Hey pilots,[/p][p]I'm beyond hyped to unveil [i]Celestial Divide[/i], the newest zero‑G arena! Floating in the middle of a sprawling asteroid belt, this stunning venue is framed by two massive space stations glowing in rival team colors. From the opening faceoff to the final point, every match here feels like it’s being broadcast across the galaxy.[/p][p][i]Celestial Divide[/i] feels like the ultimate stage - wide sightlines, slowly spinning stations at your back, and the void stretching endlessly beyond. Whether you’re making gravity‑defying saves or chaining dashes through the asteroid field, this is your chance to make history in the stars.[/p][p][b]✨ What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand‑new space arena: [i]Celestial Divide[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Two colossal stations with dynamic lighting and crowd energy[/p][/*][*][p]An asteroid belt backdrop that gives the arena a sense of epic scale[/p][/*][*][p]Available now in all core modes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.5.8 - Big UI updates
notes.content:
[p]Lots of changes, tweaks, QOL, and other bits and bops![/p][list][*][p]Along with a new beefed-up menu system, keybindings are now available for both KBM and gamepad. You can seamlessly change between either, as well as use Xbox, Dualshock, or even Switch controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, there's no more host migration for the time being, as that was making some weird  bugs, mostly in the end-game menu, and making games unjoinable.[/p][/*][*][p]The new "ready-up" system at end-game allows for a new game to be seamlessly created at the end of a game. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The tutorial is hidden (just for now!) as we are working through some gameplay tweaks, such as playing with the idea of getting rid of the ball dislodging when it hits the wall, or perhaps only at high speeds. As you all help me test more, we can decide if this means we no longer need separate hands for controls or if switching hands is a needed thing. I kind of like the idea of it but we'll see how this game evolves.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a song to the front end[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Throw aiming gets cancelled when an Air Dash is performed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some aiming stuttering issues on the client which caused the ball to not go where the player thought they were aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Some vfx additions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Give it a try and let me know how it feels in the Discord!

[/p]

notes.title: 0.5.7.1 update
notes.content:
[h1][u][i][b]Alpha 0.5.7.1 is live![/b][/i][/u][/h1][p][/p][p]Are you in [url="https://discord.gg/Ngee6X93bj"]THE PITCH Discord[/url] yet? Opt in to early playtesting, receive updates, kick it with a cool and funny community, give suggestions, life advice, share cat pics, your opinion on Voodoo Chips, etc[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Ngee6X93bj" style="button"]Join THE PITCH Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes/Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Various networking and host migration bugfixes[/p][/*][*][p]Menu tweaks; some previews of modes to come (!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b] (version 0.1) added to [b]Training[/b] section. Please let me know if you break it and [i]please[/i] share with me how![/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes movement would feel frustrating or unexpected with collisions with head or feet on some objects, so the standard [b]capsule height[/b] for the player is now [b]shorter[/b] for less collision with head and feet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grabbing [/b]players can now get [b]stunned[/b] from [b]attacks[/b] by [b]grabbed[/b] players. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Grabbing[/b] players will also get [b]stunned[/b] if they are brought to a [b]wall[/b] or [b]buoy[/b] and knocked off the grabbed player - even if they're on the same team. No more hitching a ride forever![/p][/*][*][p]Player in-game [b]nametags[/b] are now hidden behind objects and the ball. notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
0.5.5 is live
[list]
[*] major network updates for spawning after a goal/resetting a faceoff
[*] more air control. airborne acceleration 300 -> 450, over max speed deceleration 300 -> 350, braking deceleration airborne unchanged at 20.
[*] major punching/combat overhaul, added some different combat animations to the punch right to toy around with
[*] new player stunned vfx
[*] in game and front end music player bug fixes
[*] solved issues with hand thruster visual bugs
[*] various bug/edges cases with color assignments at game start
[*] fixed (lack of) collision bug with goal posts
[*] fixed control bug where player would occasionally not turn to where the camera is pointing when first aiming
[*] fixed audio bug where thruster sound occurred when entering directional input while aiming
[*] slightly bigger arena
[*] adjusted node, goal, goal screen, defense zone, and dust particle locations and sizes to fit bigger arena
[*] update faceoff locations
[*] fixed camera interpolation to be more responsive when aiming while air dashing
[*] general character orient while aiming improvements
[*] added new kits to the locker room
[/list]

Be sure to join the Discord to get the latest updates sooner, and be involved in alpha testing. Help shape the direction of this game with an awesome community of cool people!
